heading: Appropriate congressional committees defined
lead: In this subchapter, the term “appropriate congressional committees” means—

tree.text: the Committee on Foreign Relations, the Committee on Armed Services, and the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate; and
the Committee on Foreign Affairs, the Committee on Armed Services, and the Committee on Appropriations of the House of Representatives.
